label: gen2 · rung-2b three-view model-sheet probe
pipeline: rung-2b sheet probe: one 'orthographic model sheet' prompt per noun (FRONT/SIDE/TOP left-to-right) via FLUX.1 schnell (Replicate) → exact-thirds split → per-view 16×16 mask → 8-way flip search → front-protecting repair → strict visual hull lift. 4 nouns × 2 prompt variants × 4 seeds = 32 sheets, 27 processed. Two candidate voxelizations per sheet: -hull2cap6 (front ∩ depth-capped cross-section) and -flat4 (baseline). See runs/gen2-16char-sheets/gen.json for compliance metrics.
